title: Signal fusion for renewal heuristics (notes)
content:
One-pager / scratchpad for signal fusion approach to renewal risk scoring

Purpose:
- Capture a compact, reviewable heuristic for combining multiple adoption and support signals into a single renewal-risk indicator (intended to be lightweight: sheet-first then move to model).
- Surface edge cases where simple aggregation fails (e.g., low usage but active exec engagement).
- Provide a minimally invasive tie-in for playbook actions and routing tiers.

Context / motivation:
- Existing signal lists are long and overlapping (product events, API tokens, feature usage, support volume, billing anomalies). We need a reproducible fusion that produces intuitive categories: GOOD / WATCH / AT-RISK / ESCALATE.
- Goal: reduce analyst intervention for early churn interventions while keeping high recall for true at-risk renewals.

Glossary (local terms):
- Micro-signature: a compact boolean or small-count vector summarizing short-term behavior (e.g., recent-active-days, failed-integrations, support-escalation-count).
- Decay window: number of days after which a micro-signature's weight is halved (defaults below).
- Confidence band: qualitative label (low/med/high) for the trust in the fused score given sparse data.

Signal inventory (raw, rough):
- Monthly active seats (MAU seats) / license usage delta (30d vs 90d)
- API token calls per minute (90th pctile) and median session length
- Core feature adoption (feature-A, feature-B): DAG of feature calls (binary weekly)
- Login churn (distinct users active 30d -> 7d retention)
- Support tickets (new), severity 1-3, time-to-first-response (TTR), time-to-resolution (TTRs)
- Eval regressions flagged by QA harness (quality signal)
- Billing anomalies: invoice disputes, delayed payments, invoices >30d overdue
- Customer sentiment snippets from NPS comments (light NLP sentiment)
- Executive touchpoints (meetings recorded in CRM)
- Deployment/infra failures (private customers): error-rate spikes, degraded nodes

Micro-signature examples (working):
- adoption_gap_30 = max(0, expected-seat-usage - current-seat-usage) scaled to [0..1]
- support_stress_14 = min(1, (#sev2+ #sev1 in 14d)/3)
- api_surge_decay = 1 if 90p_api_qps < baseline*0.6 for 21d window -> indicates dropoff
- exec_engagement = 1 if >=1 exec meeting in last 90d else 0
- invoice_flag = 1 if any invoice >30d overdue else 0

Heuristic fusion (proposed):
- Weighted additive score: risk_raw = 0.35*adoption_gap_30 + 0.20*support_stress_14 + 0.15*api_surge_decay + 0.10*invoice_flag + 0.10*(1 - exec_engagement) + 0.10*quality_regression_flag
- Normalize to 0..100: HealthScore = round(100 * (1 - risk_raw))

Thresholds (examples to iterate on):
- HealthScore >= 80 => GREEN (no action)
- 60 <= HealthScore < 80 => AMBER (automated outreach + playbook 1)
- 40 <= HealthScore < 60 => RED (CS owner alerted, 1:1 health check)
- HealthScore < 40 => ESCALATE (SE/AE + exec outreach, possible financial review)

Playbook tie-ins (automation first):
- AMBER: trigger: targeted email with 2 resources + invite for enablement session; CAF ticket assigned to CS Ops for sampling
- RED: create renewal-risk case in CRM, assign CS owner, recommended 2-week check cadence, propose canary upsell/discount options if churn likely
- ESCALATE: finance + legal review for billing remediation, customer success director loop-in, SLA check for private deployments

Confidence / edge rules:
- If exec_engagement==1 and HealthScore < 50 => lower priority: mark confidence=low and require human review before escalation (exec touchpoints can mask usage drop)
- If invoice_flag==1 and exec_engagement==0 => bump risk weight for invoice_flag by +0.15 (billing pain correlates strongly with churn historically)
- Sparse accounts (<=3 seats): treat feature adoption signals as low-confidence — rely more on billing + support signals

Calibration notes (how we expect to iterate):
- Phase 0: implement score in sheet using last 12 months of historical signals for 500 accounts (cohort sample). Run confusion matrix vs actual renewals.
- Phase 1: add decay windows per micro-signature and tune weights to maximize F1 on at-risk label while constraining false positives for GREEN to <10%.
- Phase 2: move to lightweight model (logistic regression) if additive heuristics show inconsistent performance across cohorts. Always keep heuristics readable for GTM.

Open questions / TODOs (quick list):
- [ ] Agree canonical list of signals and single source-of-truth for each (events DB vs billing vs CRM). (Owner: Miguel)
- [ ] Decide default decay windows: 14d for support, 21d for API, 90d for exec touches (Owner: Eleni)
- [ ] Create sample sheet with 6-month rolling windows and compute HealthScore for N=500 (Owner: Aisha) - due 2024-11-01
- [ ] Add quality regression flag mapping from QA harness (PR: github.com/redwood/qa-harness/pull/67)
- [ ] Define escalation contact matrix by ARR band (small/mid/enterprise)

Quick worked example (toy):
- Account Alpha: adoption_gap_30=0.6, support_stress_14=0.2, api_surge_decay=0.0, invoice_flag=0, exec_engagement=1, quality_regression_flag=0 -> risk_raw=0.35*0.6+0.20*0.2+0+0+0+0=0.21 -> HealthScore=79 -> AMBER
- Account Beta: adoption_gap_30=0.9, support_stress_14=0.7, api_surge_decay=1, invoice_flag=1, exec_engagement=0, quality_regression_flag=1 -> risk_raw~0.35*0.9+0.20*0.7+0.15*1+0.10*1+0.10*1+0.10*1=0.315+0.14+0.15+0.10+0.10+0.10=0.915 -> HealthScore=9 -> ESCALATE

Notes to self (style):
- Keep heuristics explainable to CS reps; show micro-signature breakouts on the health card in Console.
- Add a short "why this changed" log when a customer's HealthScore moves 20+ points in 7 days.

References / links for next steps:
- Confluence draft: renewal-framework (linked above)
- Historical renewal labels export: s3://redwood-exports/cs/renewal_labels_2023_2024.csv (ask data infra for ACL)
- Slack thread: #cs-risk-models-thread-2024 (thread with sample confusion matrices)

End of notes.

(rough, iterating)
